dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: The Knights of Favonius recently received word of a disguised thief in the bazaar. I'm here to bring him into custody.

choices.text: Are you actually handling petty thieves like this?

response.speaker: Lohen
response.text: Haha, it's just been far too peaceful lately. And I honestly have no idea why, but ever since I've been stationed at Dornman Port, even the Treasure Hoarders have been reluctant to show up...

response.speaker: Lohen
response.text: It's rare to find someone so clueless... sorry, so "brave" these days. I really must entertain him properly.

response.speaker: Lohen
response.text: Anyway, Honorary Knight, have you encountered any suspicious individuals here recently?

response.speaker: Lohen
response.text: Hm? Are you implying that he's gone to ground? Now that is interesting.

choices.text: Not even going to let a petty thief off the hook?
